ticket.title: WebESS - Time and Attendance – Cancelled Leave Is Still Displayed as Approved Leave

scope: Bug: a leave date with an original Completed transaction (Amount=1) and a later cancellation transaction (Amount=0) must not show as Approved Leave in Time and Attendance. Read-only run on dev with the default admin account; the affected employee data (03/09/2026) may not belong to this account.

cases.title: Time and Attendance page loads for the signed-in user (Sep 2026)

steps.action: Open Time and Attendance, navigate to September 2026
steps.expected: Calendar/list renders with no error; days display statuses
steps.actual: Attendance page rendered (My attendance, week view) with no error; day buttons e.g. 'Mon 05/10 · No records'; other week 31 Aug–6 Sep rendered 'Tue 01/09 · (VN) National Day'.

cases.title: Cancelled leave date (03/09/2026) is not shown as Approved Leave
cases.preconditions: Account has a leave on a date later cancelled (Amount=0)
cases.notes: Original repro (03/09/2026) belongs to another employee; used equivalent data on this account (24/03/2026 cancellation Amount=0 inside completed 23–31/03 leave).

steps.action: Find a date in Time and Attendance that has a cancelled leave and check its status
steps.expected: Date is not labelled Approved Leave
steps.actual: Time-off history shows 23/03–31/03 Casual Leave 7 days Completed plus 24/03 Casual Leave 0 days Completed (cancellation). Attendance week 23–29 Mar: 'Tue 24/03 · No records' (not Approved Leave).

cases.title: Still-effective approved leave remains shown as Approved Leave
cases.preconditions: Account has an effective approved leave

steps.action: Find a date with an effective approved leave
steps.actual: Same week: 'Mon 23/03 · Casual leave · Approved', 'Wed 25/03', 'Thu 26/03', 'Fri 27/03' all 'Casual leave · Approved'.

observations: Week summary on 5–11 Oct showed Absence hours 32 while every day read No records (not investigated).
